items.caption: This seal-script-style rendering presents 忘 as 心 with 亡, the phonetic element in the recorded analysis.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style rendering of 忘 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the received analysis of 忘 as 心 plus 亡 and is identified as a modern redraw in a historical script style, rather than an artifact image.

limitations.text: This modern redraw does not establish 忘’s earliest form or date. The listed bronze and later examples do not verify an oracle-bone form or show the individual inscription variants.
